question: Which of the following places in India has the widest difference between day and night temperatures?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thar.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Thar desert experiences the highest diurnal range of temperature.**
 
• This is because of the fact** that sand (found in ample quantity in this region) gains and loses heat very quickly.**
 
• As a result of this phenomenon, there is a wide difference between day and night temperatures in this region.
 
• **The day temperature may rise to 50°C and drop down to near 15°C the same night.**
